# Foundations

Every scope answers the same five questions. This is the answer that sets each scope's values; open a scope for all five, its tokens and its specimen.

| Scope | Values | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Typography](./typography.md) | Regular | Regular body; the display does the shouting. |
| [Color](./color.md) | Vivid | Vivid color is the brand. |
| [Spacing](./spacing.md) | Spacious | Big space makes big moments. |
| [Shape](./shape.md) | Pill | Pill controls feel playful. |
| [Elevation](./elevation.md) | Pronounced | Pronounced shadows add depth. |
| [Motion](./motion.md) | Relaxed | Relaxed, springy motion. |
| [Iconography](./iconography.md) | Larger than the text | Larger icons hold their own next to big type. |
| [Theming](./theming.md) | Light and dark | Light and dark ship as standard. |
| [Accessibility](./accessibility.md) | Touch size | Visitors come from social posts on phones. |
| [Naming](./naming.md) | Lowercase words in paths | Lowercase paths read the same everywhere. |
| [Voice and tone](./voice.md) | Playful | Big words, few of them. |
| [Components](./components.md) | Also for emphasis and size | Variants for emphasis and size let each campaign look a little different. |
